questions.title: Default 3D lighting
questions.question: The sheet shows each 3D fractal twice: current default lighting (shadow + ambient occlusion) and path traced (256 samples, about 1-2 s each instead of 0.05 s). Which should `fw.py 3d render` use by default?
questions.why: Blind judge picked path traced for Mandelbulb and quaternion Julia, the default for Menger (sun washes out its faces).

media.alt: Contact sheet: Mandelbulb, quaternion Julia, Menger, default lighting vs path traced

options.label: Keep current default; path tracing opt-in with --pt
Path traced for curved fractals (Mandelbulb, Julia), current for Menger and boxy ones

guess.why: path tracing is 20-40x slower and lost on Menger
